name: Kelly Crifer
bio:
Kelly Crifer is a Brazilian actress with extensive experience in theater and film. She holds a Bachelor’s degree in Theater Performance and a Teaching Degree in Theater from the School of Fine Arts at the Federal University of Minas Gerais (EBA/UFMG).

Since 2010, she has been a faculty member of the Theater Open Courses at Galpão Cine Horto. Her film career began in 2009 with the short film Contagem, produced by Filmes de Plástico. In 2020, she was nominated for a Guarani Award for Brazilian Cinema for her performance in the feature film In the Heart of the World (No Coração do Mundo).
